paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: Enter inserts a newline in the composer, Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) sends.
# dsh-ctrl-enter-send
Change the DSH composer's send key from **Enter** to **Ctrl+Enter**: Enter inserts a newline, Ctrl+E
nter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) sends.
This fixes a concrete annoyance: when a Chinese IME is left in English mode, hitting Enter to start
a new line sends a half-written prompt to the AI instead.
## Install
This package is a DSH bundle distributed from GitHub. Install it with the DSH CLI (the official git-
install path) and pin the release tag:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The plugin is a bundle: after installation it is appended to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` a

nd activates the next time the page loads (a page refresh is enough; no DSH restart needed).
- Pinni
ng the tag (or a commit: `github:Geopanret/dsh-ctrl-enter-send#<sha>`) is recommended, so later push

es cannot silently change what you run. Omit the `#<ref>` to track the default branch.
- No build st
ep and no install-script approval are needed: this package is plain JavaScript and ships its built a
rtifacts directly (`client.js` is the whole browser bundle). pnpm does not need an `allowBuilds` ent

ry.
- Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-ctrl-enter-send` (or from the P
ll with `dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-ctrl-enter-send` (or from the Plugins page).
Compatibility: DSH `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0` (declared in `engines.dsh`; tested on 0.2.1-rc.5).
## Behavior
| Action (focus in the main chat composer) | Before | After |

| Enter | send (or queue/steer while running) | **newline** (same as Shift+Enter) |
| Shift+Enter |

newline | newline (unchanged) |
| Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter | complementary delivery mode | **send**, e
xactly like the Send button (while running it follows Settings → General → busy-Enter: queue or stee

r) |
| Empty draft + Ctrl+Enter while running with queued messages | steer all queued messages | unc

hanged |
| Enter while the `/` or `@` menu is open | select the highlighted item | unchanged |
| Ent

er while an IME is composing | confirm the composition | unchanged |
| Alt+Enter / Ctrl+Shift+Enter

/ AltGraph+Enter | ignored by the built-in keymap | unchanged |
| Other inputs (rename, inline messa
ge edit, settings, dialogs, question cards) | unchanged | unchanged |
Clicking the Send button is unchanged; it and Ctrl+Enter use the same "plain Enter" gesture.
## How it works
The plugin is browser-only. At page boot it installs one capture-phase `keydown` listener on `window
` and rewrites the modifier flags of the event object, so the composer's existing keymap takes its o
wn newline branch (Shift+Enter) or its own send branch (plain Enter):

- plain Enter → `shiftKey = true` (built-in newline);
- Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on a non-empty draft → `ctrlK

ey/metaKey = false` (built-in send);
- empty draft keeps the built-in Cmd/Ctrl+Enter steer-all gestu

re;
- menus, IME composition, Alt/AltGraph and every other input are left alone.
DOM contract used (DSH 0.2.1-rc.x): `[data-composer-input]`, `[data-composer-card]`, `[data-trigger-
menu]`, `[data-composer-overlay]`, `[data-composer-placeholder]`. If any marker is missing, the plug
in falls back to the built-in behavior instead of guessing — the worst case is "no change", never a
back to the built-in behavior instead of guessing — the worst case is "no change", never a mis-send.
If overriding the event flags is impossible in some environment, the plugin falls back to stopping t
he original event and replaying a synthetic Enter with the intended flags.
## Known limitations
- The shortcuts cheat sheet/settings page still shows the built-in fixed rows "Enter = send" and "Cm
d/Ctrl+Enter = complementary delivery". Those are read-only fixed entries owned by the built-in pack

age and cannot be rewritten by a third-party plugin; the actual behavior is the one above.
- The old
Ctrl+Enter "complementary delivery mode" semantics are replaced by the primary send gesture (that i
s the point of this plugin). The empty-draft "steer all queued messages" gesture is deliberately pre

served.
- DSH upgrades may rename the `data-composer-*` markers; the plugin then silently reverts to
the built-in keys. Update the selectors in `client.js` after such an upgrade.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`client.js` is the whole client bundle (no build step); changes are picked up by DSH's client HMR wa
tcher without restarting DSH. Host-side `index.js` changes need a restart.
